items.text: Saquon Barkley ruled OUT for Week 5 along with DeVonta Smith and Hollywood Brown for Eagles.
items.why: Final injury report; hamstring for Barkley.
items.implication: Eagles RB committee shifts heavily; WR targets redistribute.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/carries for remaining PHI RBs; more targets to other WRs/TE.

items.text: Lamar Jackson OUT for Ravens Week 5.
items.implication: Ravens offense without dual-threat QB; backup starts.
items.opportunity: Potential boost to Ravens pass-catchers volume or run game depending on backup.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT for Jets Week 5.
items.opportunity: Clear path for backup RBs in carries and targets.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love listed IN; not on final injury report.
items.why: Cleared; full-go comments despite ankle maintenance.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; nickname push as Brown Gobbler for target/fantasy production. Bengals injuries could boost.
items.why: Workload and matchup vs MIA; potential pass-game upside if Chase/Higgins limited.

items.opportunity: Increased role for remaining WAS pass-catchers.
Boost to Ladd McConkey and other Chargers WRs.
More targets to Alec Pierce, Josh Downs, Tyler Warren.

items.why: Short-term IR with ankle; misses next four.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/targets for Courtland Sutton, RJ Harvey involvement or other WRs.

items.why: Final report IN; returning from elbow.
items.implication: WAS offense full strength at QB.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love projected 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier; gut says much better role this week despite prior usage criticism and ankle maintenance. Downside still accounted for.
items.why: Fan/media pressure on prior low usage; not on final IR; limited practice but full-go.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex with upside if role expands as expected.
items.opportunity: Higher snap/carry/route share vs recent weeks.
items.conflict: Prior low usage creates projection uncertainty.

items.text: Loves Nico Collins vs Titans; ranks as WR8. Volume and red-zone usage plus soft matchup.
items.why: Target hog in favorable matchup vs TEN.

items.text: Long-term multi-risk on Malik Nabers: knee, lingering shoulder, potential JJ McCarthy QB change, coaching staff tendencies. Frustration over second-half targets noted. Good play this week but stacked risks.
items.why: Sore knee missed practice; target frustration; multiple future downside vectors.
items.implication: Monitor closely ROS; this week still viable.
items.conflict: Elite talent vs accumulating injury/coaching/QB risks.
